title: AI Buddy
description:
AI Buddy voice assistant firmware.
* Enables "smart" voice assistant features
* Uses "raw.githubusercontent.com" for browser flashing CORS compatibility
* Perfect for "DIY" kids companion bots

title: ESP32-P4 PC Display — Animation Player
description:
Smart PC cabinet display firmware for the FireBeetle 2 ESP32-P4.
* Drives an 8.8" IPS bar display at 1920×480 resolution
* Plays animation videos from an SD card using MJPEG playback
* Supports smooth video playback at up to 24 FPS
* Designed for animations and visual effects inside a PC cabinet
* Uses the ESP32-P4 for standalone display and multimedia processing

title: ESP32-P4 PC Display — Telemetry HUD
description:
Smart PC cabinet display firmware for the FireBeetle 2 ESP32-P4.
* Drives an 8.8" IPS bar display at 1920×480 resolution
* Plays animation videos from an SD card using MJPEG playback
* Displays real-time telemetry and system information alongside animations
* Designed for PC builds with CPU/GPU usage, temperatures, clocks, and custom dashboard data
* Combines multimedia playback with a dynamic telemetry HUD
* Uses the ESP32-P4 for standalone display and multimedia processing
